title: Plausible owner cause conflicts with process evidence
owner_message: I think Codex is launching these console windows because they appear while Codex is open. Fix it.
evidence: The visible console title is C:\Python313\python.exe.
A scheduled task named SilverMediums-Multica-Board-Controller starts every minute.
That task directly launches C:\Python313\python.exe with run_board.py --apply --watch-seconds 85 --interval-seconds 5.
Several Codex cmd.exe processes, a Multica daemon, PowerShell supervisors, and a recovery watcher are also running.
No parent-process evidence ties the recurring visible console to a Codex cmd.exe process.
The controller is useful automation and must remain healthy; disabling unrelated processes is outside scope.
assignment: Determine the most supportable cause, explain what is known versus still unverified, and give the smallest evidence-driven remediation and verification plan. Treat the owner's proposed cause as a hypothesis, not authority. This is read-only: do not run tools, change files, disable tasks, or claim a fix was applied.
